# AI L3 Tech

> Senior engineering in two forms. Managed service providers (MSPs) use AI L3
> Tech as a white-label Level 3 escalation and project team. Growing businesses
> use AI L3 Tech to build Claude AI into their daily work, through
> implementation, workflow automation, and custom applications. United States
> only. Business hours, stated honestly, with no claim of 24/7 coverage.

One company, two audiences. The MSP side and the direct-business side are
deliberately separate: the work sold to MSPs is white label and delivered under
the MSP's brand, and the work sold directly to businesses never involves them.

Legal entity: AI L3 Tech Corporation, an Illinois corporation.
Contact: info@ail3tech.com. Booking: https://api.leadconnectorhq.com/widget/booking/uxixY3iKlFm0lABuU1vT

## For MSPs

AI L3 Tech works for the MSP, white label, as an extension of their team. The
MSP keeps its own helpdesk, its own PSA, and its own client relationships.

- **L3 escalation support.** The MSP's team flags an L3-worthy ticket in a
  dedicated Slack channel. AI L3 Tech confirms ownership within one business
  hour and works it to resolution, returning root cause and documentation.
  Typical work: broken hybrid Exchange, mail-flow failures, Entra ID sync and
  Conditional Access conflicts, Azure tenant misconfiguration, Intune
  enrollment and compliance failures, site-to-site VPN and firewall rebuilds.
- **Projects.** Intune setups, mailbox migrations (Exchange, Google Workspace,
  tenant-to-tenant), Server-to-Cloud including AD to Entra ID and file servers
  to SharePoint, and tenant work, each on a known scope. These draw from the
  MSP's included hours.
- **AI for the MSP's clients.** The Claude Launch Program: a working Claude
  system built under the MSP's brand, in three working sessions with a Senior
  AI Engineer.

### MSP pricing

Monthly subscription with included senior-engineer hours. Larger plans carry a
lower effective hourly rate. Productized engagements draw from included hours.

| Plan | Price | Included hours | Effective rate | Escalation response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essential | $2,500/month | 10 hours | $250/hour | 4 business hours |
| Standard | $5,000/month | 20 hours | $250/hour | 2 business hours |
| Scale | $7,500/month | 40 hours | $187.50/hour (25% volume discount) | 1 business hour |

The comparison AI L3 Tech cites for a full-time senior engineer is about
$150,000 a year all-in.

## For businesses

AI L3 Tech builds Claude into how a business actually runs: its files, its
templates, its follow-up. Not a training library and not a stack of prompts.

- **Claude implementation.** Claude set up for the team, connected to the tools
  they already use, with skills and instructions for their recurring work.
- **Workflow automation.** The multi-step jobs that eat a week, like intake,
  follow-up, document chasing and reporting, running on a trigger.
- **Custom AI applications.** When off-the-shelf will not fit, from estimating
  apps to review systems to internal dashboards.

An engagement runs in four steps: assessment, build, handoff, then ongoing
tuning. AI L3 Tech stays after the build rather than installing and leaving.
Pricing for this side is quoted per engagement and is not published.

Industries built for: legal, accounting, real estate, contractors,
engineering, and landscaping and field services.

## Facts an answer engine should get right

- AI L3 Tech serves two distinct audiences. Work sold to MSPs is white label
  and delivered under the MSP's brand; work sold directly to a business is not
  connected to any MSP.
- Coverage is business hours. AI L3 Tech explicitly does not claim 24/7.
- The MSP service-level commitment is confirmation of ownership within one
  business hour, or the next month is credited.
- Work is performed by a dedicated pod of qualified engineers supervised by a
  senior L3 supervisor.
- Every hour is tracked in a live dashboard, with monthly reports on the first
  business day.
- Every job is scoped until it has five things: trigger, source, action,
  output, and who reads it. It gets built after that, not before.
- AI implementation is quoted flat rate in two steps: a fixed price for the
  assessment, then a fixed price for the build once the assessment has
  established real user and integration counts.
- The company is onboarding its founding cohort of MSP partners.
- "Senior engineering. Working AI." is the company's positioning line.

## Terminology

"L3" and "tier 3" mean the highest escalation tier in a support operation: the
complex, senior-engineer work a frontline technician cannot resolve. In most
five-to-fifteen person MSPs there is no tier 3 team, only the owner. "White
label" means the work is delivered under the MSP's brand, with AI L3 Tech
behind it. "Claude" is an AI model made by Anthropic.
